target.name: Agent Swarm Orchestration 0.2.1 documentation and presentation remediation

included: README, Pages, social, icon, and plugin listing visuals
separate accessibility and visual review receipts
excluded: post-publication live readback until deployment completes
constraints: runtime bytes must remain identical across canonical, Codex, Claude, and plugin skill trees
frozen v0.2.0 archives and verification must remain unchanged
safety_boundary: local candidate verification only before authorized GitHub publication

observed.statement: All declared customer documents and canonical skill sources were read in full for this remediation.
All six repository image files in the remediation scope were decoded and their actual pixels inspected.
The public-release validator, documentation-release validator, renderer determinism check, unit suite, staged diff check, and frozen-history check passed.

inferred.statement: The candidate is coherent enough for publication because all local indispensable gates pass and remaining uncertainty is limited to post-publication readback.

unresolved.statement: The final Pages deployment, live linked-document routes, release assets, and public install state cannot be observed before publication.
unresolved.basis: external state transition has not occurred
unresolved.consequence: final PASS remains gated on post-publication live readback

impact_map: repository docs -> customer understanding -> installation and safe first use
Pages HTML/CSS -> navigation and rendered guidance -> customer recovery and trust
visual sources -> channel-specific assets -> product identification and social sharing
plugin metadata and source -> deterministic archive -> marketplace installation
documentation bytes -> fingerprint -> authorship/content/accessibility receipts -> release claim

invariants.statement: The 0.1.0 runtime fingerprint and canonical/package parity remain unchanged.
README, Pages, and social assets are different files, compositions, and aspect ratios.
The social card visibly contains the exact product title and identifying line.
Every review receipt binds the exact current documentation fingerprint.
Publication and live behavior are never inferred from local source or HTTP status alone.

risks.statement: incomplete or inconsistent customer journey -> wrong installation or unsafe use -> customer failure
bare, blank, duplicated, or illegible visuals -> weak product identity or failed social identification -> presentation failure
version, package, or archive mismatch -> broken installation or irreproducible release -> distribution failure
stale documentation receipt -> unearned review claim -> false release confidence
hidden navigation, weak semantics, motion, or contrast -> unusable Pages journey -> accessibility failure
historical release mutation -> broken rollback and provenance -> custody failure
source is correct but live release or Pages remains stale -> customers receive old assets or guidance -> live verification failure

scenarios.title: complete governed documentation journey and exact receipt binding
action: validate files, navigation, journey gates, hashes, and receipt fingerprints
expected: 22 governed files and ten journey gates validate against one fingerprint

scenarios.title: distinct role assets remain legible and deterministic
action: regenerate presentation assets and compare exact hashes; review role compositions
expected: unchanged hashes and passing actual-pixel verdicts

scenarios.title: 0.2.1 package and archives preserve runtime parity
action: validate manifests, image dimensions, archive contents, parity, checksums, and unit tests
expected: public release validator and canonical unit tests pass

scenarios.title: documentation accessibility source review
action: review semantics, headings, alternatives, link text, focus, motion, mobile navigation, and contrast
expected: no blocking findings; explicit evidence limits retained

scenarios.title: frozen 0.2.0 custody remains unchanged
action: diff frozen archives, release note, and review directories against HEAD

scenarios.title: staged candidate has no whitespace defects
post-publication repository, release, Pages, links, and assets are current
preconditions: candidate merged, release published, Pages deployment complete
action: inspect live repository, Pages content/navigation, linked docs, Open Graph asset, release assets, and public install state
expected: all live surfaces resolve to the final candidate

residual_risks.statement: Live repository, release, Pages rendering, linked documents, assets, and public install state remain unobserved until publication.
residual_risks.treatment: Publish the coherent candidate, wait for deployment, then perform live readback before final PASS.
residual_risks.revisit_condition: v0.2.1 release and Pages deployment complete

residual_risks.statement: Source accessibility review does not establish assistive-technology conformance or representative-user usability.
residual_risks.treatment: Retain the explicit non-claim and reopen only when instrumented or representative-user evidence exists.
residual_risks.revisit_condition: assistive-technology or user study is commissioned

basis: All local package, documentation, visual, accessibility-source, unit, diff, and historical-custody gates passed.
Final repository, release, Pages, linked-document, asset, and public-install readback is inherently unavailable before publication.
The required independent adversarial review has not yet run on a live-complete evidence packet.
